sentences.en: I have seen certified idiots lie better than the separatists.
sentences.zh: 我见过一些被证实是笨蛋的人比分离主义者还擅长撒谎。

sentences.en: Fascists like Lakhdar Benkoula and the separatists are certified sociopaths.

sentences.en: Warning, the guy in front of you is a certified nutter!
sentences.zh: 警告，你面前的这个人是个十足的精神病人！

senses.zh: （尤指书面）证明,发证书给…,证明（某人）患有精神病,颁发（或授予）专业合格证书
